# Today on Hacker News

### AI/ML
The field of artificial intelligence continues to advance with Anthropic surpassing OpenAI to become the most valuable AI startup. This achievement highlights the growing importance of AI in various industries. Another notable development is the use of Godot game engine for explaining Navier-Stokes fluid simulation, showcasing the versatility of this technology.

### Programming
The programming community has seen significant contributions recently. The Zig programming language has undergone a reworked build system, aiming to improve efficiency and productivity. Additionally, Pandoc Templates have been released, providing users with a convenient way to create templates for documents.

### Hardware
In the realm of hardware, IXI's autofocusing lenses are almost ready to replace multifocal glasses, offering a promising solution for vision correction. Furthermore, Helios – a plug-in solar system – has been showcased, demonstrating the potential for renewable energy generation at any address in Britain.

### Other
The recent article "What Happened to the Locusts?" by explosion-scratch explores an intriguing topic, while "Vibe Coding Is Not Engineering" by jhevans provides insight into the differences between coding and engineering. SQLite has been recognized as a reliable solution for durable workflows, and Corporate America is starting to ration AI due to rising costs.

### Finance
A Danish pension fund has excluded SpaceX from its investment portfolio, citing governance and valuation concerns.
